subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT an objective of the National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy (2007) of the Government of India?

options.text: To maximise the focus on rehabilitation without really caring for resettlement
To integrate rehabilitation concerns into the development planning and implementation process
To minimise displacement and to promote, as far as possible, non-displacing or least-displacing alternatives
To provide a better standard of living, making concerted efforts for providing sustainable income to the affected families

solution:
The correct answer is__** To maximise the focus on rehabilitation without really caring for resettlement.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy (2007)** of the **Government of India** aims to provide better **living standards and sustainable income **to affected families.
 
• Another objective is to **integrate rehabilitation concerns** into the development planning and implementation process.
 
• The policy also aims to minimize displacement and promote **non-displacing or least-displacing alternatives.**
 
• However, the policy** does not** prioritize rehabilitation over resettlement.
 
• **Resettlement **is an important aspect of the policy, as it aims to provide affected families with a new place to live and sources of income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy **aims** to accomplish the following:

 
 
• **better living conditions** for affected families through coordinated efforts to provide sustainable income;
 
• integration of **rehabilitation **concerns into the development planning and implementation process; and,
 
• in cases where displacement is due to **land acquisition, **facilitation of harmonious relationships between the requiring body and affected families through mutual cooperation.
 
• The policy also ensures that special care is taken to **protect the rights of the weaker sections **of society, particularly members of the **Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes**, and creates obligations on the State for their treatment with concern and sensitivity.
